values: 一名内向文静的辅助，能够记录友军的增益并对其重复施加。
An introverted Support who can track allies' buffs and reapplies them again.
Curses are also a kind of knowledge.
Hmm... I remember reading this passage. Oh, is something the matter.
This book contains the knowledge I seek.
All knowledge lies within these pages.
谢谢，很棒的礼物。能和姐姐分享就好了……
What a great gift! Can I share it with my sister...?
在别人认为你会带来灾厄的时候，你最好真的会。
If they say you're a curse, then be one.
翻开泛黄的书页，文字构筑的世界如同梦境般光怪陆离。
Turn the yellowed pages, and step into a bizarre dream spun from words.
I can do a bit of reading while I wait.
I wonder where my sister went...
伊莎贝拉和姐姐西尔维娜都沉默寡言，但西尔维娜是认为语言沟通过于低效，而伊莎贝拉则是纯粹地不善言辞。
Both Isabella and her elder sister, Silvina, are quiet. While Silvina sees language as an inefficient means of communication, Isabella is simply bad with words.
伊莎贝拉对书可谓是来者不拒，为此，对阅读没什么兴趣的西尔维娜也不得不经常翻阅书本，为她筛选掉一些不适合她的书籍。
Isabella is a voracious reader. Despite having little interest in reading, Silvina often has to flip through books to filter out those unsuitable for her sister.
除了“姐姐”之外，伊莎贝拉学到的另一个重要的词语就是“友人”。
Aside from "sister", "friend" is another important word Isabella has learned.
作为控制西尔维娜的人质，伊莎贝拉不得不深居简出——还好，她被软禁的地方提供了足够的书本，让她的日子不至于太过无聊。
Isabella is a hostage held to keep Silvina in check. Thankfully, there are enough books in her place of confinement to stave off boredom.
伊莎贝拉手中的死魂之书可以复刻现实的文字，因此在需要外出时，伊莎贝拉会事先在其中存上几本旅途中的读物。
Isabella can replicate real-world texts within her Tome of the Dead. Before a trip, she always makes sure to store a few books inside to read during the journey.
伊莎贝拉有着“被诅咒的天赋”，这既是形容她那天然的灾厄力量，又是形容她那强大到惊人的天赋水平。
It is fitting to say that Isabella was "born to be cursed". She brings disasters wherever she goes, and in a way, this is a remarkable talent in itself.
对于自己天然吸引着灾难与不幸的命运，伊莎贝拉心知肚明，就连她与姐姐西尔维娜的处境，也与她的这份力量不无关系。
Isabella is aware of her natural affinity with calamities and misfortunes. The hardship she and Silvina endure is not merely a coincidence—it echoes the ominous force that dwells within her.
西尔维娜天生在情感的感受与表达上更加冷漠，但伊莎贝拉只是更善于隐藏自身的真实感受。
While Silvina has an inherent emotional indifference, Isabella tends to hide her true feelings.
如果伊莎贝拉愿意，她可以在一日内阅读完百万字的文本，有必要的话，甚至能熟练应用并背诵——但代价是之后会虚弱许多天。
If Isabella wishes to, she can finish reading a million words in a day, even memorizing and applying them with ease. However, she will be left drained for several days afterward.
伊莎贝拉的运动能力就和西尔维娜的读书天赋一样的差。
When it comes to athletic abilities, Isabella is just like Silvina with books.
来，伊莎贝拉，先喝杯热牛奶。
Come, Isabella, have a glass of warm milk.
西尔维娜 & 伊莎贝拉
I can do a bit of reading while I wait.
